summary: A user reported being contacted by someone claiming to be an ethical hacker who offered to recover funds lost in a romance scam and displayed tokens in a wallet while requesting additional funds to automate withdrawal. The scheme involves a fake recovery process requiring upfront payment indicating a recovery scam.
user_mistake: Engaged with a self described ethical hacker and considered sending additional funds for recovery
prevention: Do not send funds to anyone claiming to recover lost crypto / Cease contact with unsolicited recovery offers immediately
